lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of approximately 45 high-luminance circular pixel clusters organized into five primary horizontal rows across the visible lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the circular spot centroids, forming distinct anchor nodes particularly prominent in the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features running across the upper third of the flank, characterized by high-luminance upper edges and shadowed lower edges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low-density distribution of small, high-luminance blobs scattered across the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, with higher clusters observed toward the base.
